briefdescription.para: Thread-safe simulated allocation counter used by MEM-* tests.

detaileddescription.para: Increment on simulated "alloc", decrement on simulated "dealloc". A balanced counter (net == 0) indicates no leak.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-01: Model load failure throws std::runtime_error, not UB or crash.

detaileddescription.para: A P5MockPlugin with fail_load=true must propagate std::runtime_error when loadModel() is invoked. The exception must NOT be swallowed silently.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-02: Inference request with null plugin returns failure cleanly.

detaileddescription.para: Constructing an AsyncInferenceEngine with a nullptr plugin must not crash; a submitted request should resolve to a failed response.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-03: RAII wrapper releases model resource on scope exit.

detaileddescription.para: Uses SimAllocGuard to model a "model resource". Verifies the net allocation counter returns to zero after the guard leaves scope.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-04: RAII wrapper releases resource even when an exception is thrown mid-inference.
EXS-05: Double-unload is idempotent — no double-free or crash.

detaileddescription.para: Calling unloadModel() twice on P5MockPlugin must not assert or throw.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-06: Exception in callback does not corrupt scheduler state.

detaileddescription.para: A callback that throws must not prevent the scheduler from accepting and processing subsequent requests.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-08: Concurrent exception in one thread does not affect other threads' inference state.

detaileddescription.para: Starts N threads. One designated thread submits a generate-throwing request; the rest submit normal requests. All normal requests must succeed.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-10: Move of model handle transfers ownership; source is invalidated.
EXS-11: Exception during plugin registration is caught; plugin not registered.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates a plugin whose constructor throws before registration completes.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-12: Exception during batch scheduling does not lose already-queued requests.

detaileddescription.para: Submits two requests, then triggers an exception-simulating callback, then verifies the first two requests were tracked in total_requests.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-14: PromptPolicy::evaluate is exception-safe under concurrent modification (no crash or data race).
EXS-15: Inference engine restart after exception produces correct state.

detaileddescription.para: Shuts down an engine that saw a failing request, then creates a fresh engine backed by the same (fixed) plugin and verifies it operates correctly.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-16: Memory usage does not grow after 10 load/unload cycles (simulated RAII guard).

detaileddescription.para: Each cycle allocates a SimAllocGuard and releases it. The net counter must be zero at cycle completion.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-17: Plugin manager returns std::nullopt on unknown model, no exception thrown.
EXS-18: Error envelope propagates error code through exception-safe path.

detaileddescription.para: A failed InferenceResponse (success=false) carries diagnostic text that survives a move through an exception-safe code path.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-19: Strong exception guarantee — state unchanged if operation throws (simulated).

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that a quota entry's consumed value is not modified when the enforceQuota wrapper throws.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-20: Basic exception guarantee — no resource leak on partial completion (simulated).

detaileddescription.para: Allocates multiple SimAllocGuards in a loop. An exception mid-loop must leave the net counter at zero (RAII cleanup via stack unwinding).

xrefdescription.para: EXS-22: Stream abort releases partial response buffer (no leak).

detaileddescription.para: Simulates a streaming partial buffer that is aborted mid-stream. The RAII guard tracking the buffer memory must decrement on abort.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-23: Retry-on-transient wraps inference in exception-safe retry loop — succeeds on 3rd attempt.
EXS-24: Shutdown-under-exception completes without hang (timeout ≤ 50ms).

detaileddescription.para: Engine backed by a throwing plugin is shut down; the shutdown call must return within 50 ms.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-25: Exception in streaming handler does not terminate reader thread.

detaileddescription.para: A streaming callback that throws must not propagate to the engine's worker pool. The engine must remain functional for further requests.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-26: Multiple plugins can be loaded/unloaded without exception leakage (3 distinct plugins registered and unregistered).
EXS-27: Exception during quota refill leaves counter at previous valid value.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates a refill operation that throws part-way. The consumed value must remain at its pre-refill level.

xrefdescription.para: EXS-28: Exception safety gate — yields 1.0 when all EXS invariants hold.

detaileddescription.para: Aggregates a pass/fail verdict across representative invariants: RAII balance, move-only type traits, noexcept propagation.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-01: Model loading cycle (10 iterations) shows no net allocation growth (simulated RAII guard).
MEM-02: Inference request (100 cycles) shows no net allocation growth.
MEM-03: Response cache eviction correctly frees all entries.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates a fixed-capacity response cache with RAII-tracked entries.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-04: Tokenizer resource freed on scope exit (RAII pattern).
MEM-05: Grammar cache capacity limit enforced; old entries freed.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates a grammar cache that evicts when it exceeds kCapacity.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-06: LoRA adapter unload frees adapter weights (simulated size check).
MEM-07: KV-cache release triggered on session end.
MEM-08: Batch scheduler queue cleared on shutdown (no dangling pointers — simulated via RAII entries).
MEM-09: Cancelled request buffer released immediately.
MEM-10: Plugin manager cleanup releases all registered plugins on destroy.

detaileddescription.para: Uses the RAII destructor of a local LLMPluginManager to verify all plugin unique_ptrs are freed when the manager is destroyed.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-11: VRAM accounting decrements on model unload (simulated counter).
MEM-12: Stream reader releases buffer after abort signal.
MEM-13: Concurrent model loads produce no cumulative allocation growth (simulated counters, 4 threads × 5 cycles).
MEM-14: Quota manager reset frees sliding-window state.

detaileddescription.para: After removeQuota(), getLimit() returns nullopt and currentUsage() returns 0.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-15: 1 000-cycle inference stress — memory stays ≤ initial + 50 KB simulated budget.

detaileddescription.para: Each cycle allocates up to 50 bytes and frees before the next iteration. Cumulative net growth must remain within 50 000-byte budget.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-16: Response transformation pipeline releases intermediate buffers.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates a 3-stage transformation pipeline where each stage allocates and releases an intermediate buffer.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-17: Failed model download does not leak partial download buffer.
MEM-18: Policy cache clear releases all entries (size → 0).

detaileddescription.para: Simulates a policy cache via a vector of RAII-tracked entries, then clears it.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-19: LoRA certificate store prunes expired certs and releases memory.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates expiry pruning: entries older than a TTL are removed and freed.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-20: Model metadata cache respects max_entries and frees oldest.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates an LRU model metadata cache that evicts on overflow.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-21: Atomic reference count for shared model state reaches 0 on last release.
MEM-22: LLM client pooled connections freed on pool destruction.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates a connection pool that frees all connections when destroyed.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-23: Embedding cache eviction triggers value_deleter.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates a cache with a custom deleter (value_deleter) invoked on eviction.

xrefdescription.para: MEM-24: Memory gate — yields 1.0 when all MEM invariants hold.

detaileddescription.para: Validates a representative subset of memory invariants in a single assertion.

briefdescription.para: LLM Module Hardening — Phase 5 focused regression tests.

detaileddescription.para: Covers P5-L01 and P5-L02 deliverables defined in NEXT_PHASE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and ROADMAP.md (src/llm/ROADMAP.md) Phase 5 acceptance criteria:

listitem.para:
EXS-H: Exception safety audit + RAII wrapper hardening (28 tests)
Model load failure propagation, RAII lifetime guarantees, double-unload idempotency, concurrent exception isolation, move-only handle semantics, strong/basic exception guarantees, shutdown-under-exception, and an overall invariant gate.

MEM-H: Memory leak fixes — model loading, cache cleanup (24 tests)
Simulated allocation-counter approach (no external Valgrind dependency), RAII-guard tracking, KV-cache/stream/batch/scheduler teardown, quota reset, LoRA cleanup, and an overall invariant gate.

detaileddescription.para: All tests are deterministic (seed 42 where applicable) and do not require a real LLM backend.
